name: Azumaru Aya
source:
Doesn't stand out much, but gives a pretty cute impression. Due to a unmotivated personality, doesn't possess much presence, but if looked closely, she maybe cuter than Reina.

She is always reading. Because she is always absorbed in her thoughts, it is difficult to what she is thinking currently. Judging by appearance alone, seems someone who is easy to be deceived but is actually quite formidable.

Although has not developed sexually, if she targets someone, she will bring them down definitely. Possesses a very tenacious character.

Further, she is smart, even in Shogi can drive her opponent in corner, step by step.

Hobbies include everything that can satisfy her intellectual curiosity. Especially Shogi and Go. Her rank in results, do not fall under 3rd.

[Translated from [url=http://www.ume.gr.jp/product/dz/sakasa_t/sakasa_t.html]website[/url]]
